description: `retrieval.reindex` runs one DELIBERATE pass over one NAMED corpus (O8) — the same function `aeon index rebuild` calls (D15). It never fires on its own: not from status, not from a stale `search.query`, not on daemon start (V21, spy-asserted). `force` is the V17 restatement required to rebuild a corpus onto a different embedding model; without it a mismatch refuses and prices. `embeddedUsd` absent means the cost was not known — never $0.
